description: This file contains data models, helper functions, and code generation logic for Python bindings and dispatch in PyTorch's codegen system. It defines classes and functions to generate Python signatures, C++ dispatch lambdas, and handle argument parsing for Python-C++ interfacing in the PyTorch codebase.

classes.name: PythonReturns
classes.description: Data class representing the return values of a Python function signature.

classes.name: PythonArgument
classes.description: Data class representing a Python function argument, including methods for generating argument strings for codegen.

classes.name: PythonOutArgument
classes.description: Subclass of PythonArgument for output arguments, supporting multiple outputs.

classes.name: PythonSignature
classes.description: Data class representing a Python function signature, including methods for generating signature strings for codegen.

classes.name: PythonSignatureDeprecated
classes.description: Subclass of PythonSignature for deprecated signatures, with additional schema info.

classes.name: PythonSignatureNativeFunctionPair
classes.description: Data class pairing a PythonSignature with a NativeFunction.

classes.name: PythonSignatureGroup
classes.description: Data class representing a group of Python signatures for base and out variants, with methods for creation from pairs.

classes.name: DispatchLambdaArgument
classes.description: Data class representing arguments of the C++ dispatch lambda.

classes.name: PythonArgParserOutputExpr
classes.description: Data class representing the output expression of PythonArgParser for a single argument.

classes.name: DispatchLambdaArgumentExprs
classes.description: Data class representing the expressions and inits for binding Python args to C++ lambda arguments.

methods.name: format_function_signature
methods.description: Formats a Python function signature string with optional multi-line formatting.

methods.name: argument_type_str
methods.description: Converts a Type to its string representation in Python signature context.

methods.name: argument_type_str_pyi
methods.description: Converts a Type to its string representation for .pyi type hints.

methods.name: return_type_str_pyi
methods.description: Converts a Type to its string representation for return type hints.

methods.name: returns_str_pyi
methods.description: Generates the string for the return type in .pyi signatures, possibly as a structseq.

methods.name: signature
methods.description: Creates a PythonSignature from a NativeFunction, with options for method and pyi.

methods.name: signature_from_schema
methods.description: Creates a PythonSignature from a FunctionSchema, with options for category and pyi.

methods.name: structseq_fieldnames
methods.description: Returns field names for structseq return types.

methods.name: returns_structseq_pyi
methods.description: Generates structseq class code for return types in .pyi signatures.

methods.name: dispatch_lambda_args
methods.description: Generates dispatch lambda arguments from PythonSignature and NativeFunction.

methods.name: dispatch_lambda_exprs
methods.description: Generates expressions for Python args binding to C++ lambda arguments.

methods.name: arg_parser_unpack_method
methods.description: Determines the unpacking method for a Python argument type.

methods.name: arg_parser_output_expr
methods.description: Creates the RHS expression for a Python argument's PythonArgParser output.

methods.name: arg_parser_output_exprs
methods.description: Creates a map of argument names to their PythonArgParserOutputExpr.
